## Scientific/formal voice

An Independent Criterion is a separately elicited and scored observation of work-relevant performance used to test whether an assessment score transfers beyond its own case, with outcome assessors masked to that score.

### Notation

No notation is required.

### Boundary conditions

- A similar question scored by the same rubric is not an independent criterion.
- A laboratory work sample is not automatically later job performance or the study's Target Outcome.

### Testable conditions

None declared.

## Plain-language voice

It checks the answer against a different piece of work rather than against itself.
